title: Enterprise Procurement Roadmap v1 — Rig Relay
overall_status: Pre-enterprise. 7 P0 blockers must resolve before any credible procurement review.

P0_procurement_blockers.description: Must resolve before Rig Relay can credibly enter any enterprise procurement conversation.

items.title: Security Architecture Whitepaper
items.why_it_matters: First question any security team asks. Without a security architecture document, procurement stops immediately.
items.validation_strategy: Peer review by security professional. Map against OWASP ASVS.

items.title: Supply-Chain Security Pipeline (SBOM + Vulnerability Scanning)
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise procurement requires evidence of dependency management. No SBOM = automatic rejection.
items.validation_strategy: SBOM validates against SPDX schema. CI passes with vulnerability scan green. Scorecard score improves.
items.dependency_impact: Add pip-audit to dev dependencies. No runtime impact.
items.estimated_blast_radius: CI pipeline only. No code changes required.

items.title: Access Control and RBAC Model
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise requires role-based access. Single-user local-only is insufficient for team deployment.
items.validation_strategy: RBAC model reviewed against enterprise requirements. Test plan defined.
items.dependency_impact: Minimal for design phase. Implementation may add auth libraries.
items.estimated_blast_radius: High implementation impact. Touches auth, WebSocket, tool execution boundaries.

items.title: Enterprise Configuration Management
items.why_it_matters: Admins must enforce org-wide policies (provider allowlists, tool restrictions, telemetry settings).
items.validation_strategy: Policy enforcement tests. Config validation boundary tests.
items.dependency_impact: Extends existing config system. No new dependencies.
items.estimated_blast_radius: Medium. Extends config model. Backward-compatible with existing config.

items.title: Commercial and Enterprise Licensing Strategy
items.why_it_matters: AGPL-3.0 is a hard blocker for most enterprise procurement. Must define commercial path.
items.validation_strategy: Legal review. Enterprise customer feedback.
items.estimated_blast_radius: None for code. Critical for business model.

items.title: Privacy and Data Protection Documentation
items.why_it_matters: GDPR/CCPA compliance questions will arise. Need clear answers about data handling.
items.validation_strategy: Privacy review. Map against GDPR/CCPA requirements.

items.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy and Patching SLA
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise needs clear process for vulnerability reporting, triage, and remediation timelines.
items.validation_strategy: Review against ISO 29147 and OpenSSF VDP guide.

items.title: Telemetry/Evidence Boundary Documentation and Evidence Continuity Guarantee
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise procurement reviewers must see a clear four-category model: product telemetry (default-on, opt-out), remote telemetry contribution (settings-controlled), local operational observability (mandatory), enterprise audit/evidence (mandatory). Without this boundary, telemetry discussions conflate product improvement data with security evidence, weakening both.
items.validation_strategy: Procurement reviewer feedback. Automated tests proving product-telemetry-disabled preserves governance/audit/evidence records.
items.estimated_blast_radius: Low. Additive documentation and test changes.

P1_enterprise_beta_blockers.description: Required before enterprise beta program or paid pilots.

items.title: PostgreSQL Enterprise Substrate (Phase 1: Schema + Migrations)
items.why_it_matters: DuckDB is analytical substrate only. Need durable operational store for audit, tenants, config.
items.validation_strategy: Migration tests. Schema validation. Replay equivalence tests.
items.dependency_impact: Add SQLAlchemy + asyncpg or psycopg as core dependencies.
items.estimated_blast_radius: High. New subsystem. Touches analytics, coordination, evidence.

items.title: Audit Trail Tamper-Evidence (Layer 1: Hash Chain)
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise audit requirements demand tamper-evident trails. Design exists, not implemented.
items.validation_strategy: Tamper-detection tests: modify/delete/insert events, verify chain breaks.

items.title: Enterprise Evidence Pack Generator
items.why_it_matters: Self-service procurement evidence reduces sales cycle. Auto-generated packs demonstrate transparency.
items.validation_strategy: Pack generation tests. Content-light verification. Schema validation.
items.dependency_impact: None. Uses existing evidence and export infrastructure.

items.title: Hosted Deployment Architecture (Design + Prototype)
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise teams need shared state. Local-only is insufficient for team adoption.
items.validation_strategy: Multi-user integration tests. Tenant isolation tests.
items.dependency_impact: Add Postgres, potentially Redis or message queue. Web server hardening.
items.estimated_blast_radius: Very high. Touches every subsystem. New deployment paradigm.

items.title: Incident Response Plan and Security Runbook
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise security reviews require documented incident response capability.
items.validation_strategy: Tabletop exercise. Third-party review.

items.title: Enterprise Admin CLI and Health Check
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise admins need operational tooling: health checks, diagnostics, config validation, log viewing.
items.validation_strategy: Command smoke tests. Health check endpoint tests.
items.estimated_blast_radius: Medium. Adds CLI commands and server endpoints.

items.title: SLSA Build Provenance (L1-L2)
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise supply-chain security requires build attestations and signed releases.
items.validation_strategy: SLSA provenance verification. Signature verification tests.
items.dependency_impact: Add cosign or slsa-github-generator to CI.
items.estimated_blast_radius: CI pipeline only. No code changes.

items.title: Multi-Tenant Isolation (Implementation)
items.why_it_matters: Schemas exist. Need actual tenant boundaries in code: data isolation, per-tenant config, tenant-aware coordination.
items.validation_strategy: Cross-tenant data isolation tests. Tenant-scoped permission tests.

items.title: SSO and SCIM Integration
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise identity = SAML/OIDC + automated provisioning. OAuth-only is insufficient.
items.validation_strategy: SSO integration tests. SCIM provisioning tests.
items.dependency_impact: Add SAML library. May add SCIM framework.

items.title: Billing and Subscription Model
items.why_it_matters: Hosted deployment requires monetization. Needs subscription tiers, usage metering, payment integration.
items.validation_strategy: Subscription lifecycle tests. Billing accuracy tests.
items.dependency_impact: Add Stripe or equivalent billing library.

items.title: Backup, Restore, and Disaster Recovery
items.why_it_matters: Hosted service needs documented DR capability with tested recovery procedures.
items.validation_strategy: Backup integrity tests. Recovery time objective tests.
items.dependency_impact: Postgres backup tooling. Storage for backups.

P3_trust_center_commercial_polish.description: Polish for commercial launch: trust center, security questionnaire responses, documentation completeness.

items.title: Trust Center and Security Page
items.why_it_matters: Public trust center is table stakes for enterprise SaaS. Must be on static site.
items.validation_strategy: Content review. Link validation.

items.title: Admin Documentation Completeness
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise admins need comprehensive docs: deployment, configuration, operations, troubleshooting.
items.validation_strategy: Admin documentation review. Completeness scan.

items.title: Enterprise Terms of Service and DPA
items.why_it_matters: Legal docs required before any paid enterprise deal.
items.validation_strategy: Legal review.

items.title: Penetration Test and Security Assessment
items.why_it_matters: Enterprise procurement often requires third-party security assessment or pen test report.
items.validation_strategy: Independent security assessment.
items.estimated_blast_radius: May surface vulnerabilities requiring code changes.

items.title: OpenSSF Scorecard > 7.0
items.why_it_matters: Objective measure of repo hygiene. Procurement teams increasingly check this.
items.validation_strategy: Scorecard check passes with score >= 7.0.

intentionally_deferred.description: Items recognized as important but intentionally deferred past P3.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II Audit
items.reason: Requires 6-12 months of operating history with controls in place. Premature for alpha-stage tool.
items.deferred_until: Post-enterprise-beta, with 6+ months of operational data.

items.title: ISO 27001 Certification
items.reason: Requires mature ISMS with audit evidence. Not feasible for pre-revenue project.

items.title: FedRAMP Authorization
items.reason: Requires US government sponsor and extensive control implementation. Years away.
items.deferred_until: If/when US government customers exist and sponsor.

items.title: HIPAA Compliance
items.reason: Rig Relay is not a healthcare tool. BAA not needed unless healthcare use case emerges.

items.title: Air-Gapped Deployment Certification
items.reason: Local-first architecture supports it but formal certification requires dedicated testing.

out_of_scope_risks.description: Risks outside this roadmap that could block enterprise adoption.

items.title: LLM Provider Dependency Risk
items.description: Enterprise customers may restrict which LLM providers can receive code. Rig Relay currently sends prompts to external APIs. On-premises/local inference support (in development) addresses this partially.
items.impact: Some enterprises will block all external LLM API access. Local inference capability needed.
items.mitigation: Continue local inference subsystem development. Document provider data flow boundaries.

items.title: Agent Autonomy Risk
items.description: Enterprise risk teams may reject tools that give LLMs filesystem access, regardless of governance. Tool permission gating may not be sufficient for zero-trust environments.
items.impact: Conservative enterprises may require full human-in-the-loop approval for all mutations.
items.mitigation: Document tool permission model clearly. Offer 'review-only' deployment mode.

items.title: Prompt Injection Liability
items.description: No current solution for prompt injection in agentic systems. Enterprise may view this as unacceptable residual risk.
items.impact: Could block procurement entirely if security team flags OWASP LLM Top 10 risks.
items.mitigation: Be transparent about current mitigations and limitations. Invest in prompt injection defenses.

items.title: Single-Maintainer Risk
items.description: Enterprise procurement often evaluates bus factor. Single-maintainer projects are higher risk.
items.impact: Some enterprises will not adopt tools maintained by a single person.
items.mitigation: Build contributor community. Document succession/continuity plan.

items.title: AGPL License Risk
items.description: AGPL-3.0 is the most restrictive open-source license. Many enterprises have blanket prohibitions.
items.impact: Automatic rejection from enterprises with no-AGPL policies.
items.mitigation: Offer commercial license with permissive terms. Be upfront about AGPL requirements.
